basic_info.description: Gorgeous remodeled 3 BR & 2 BA in the premier Lakeshore neighborhood! Top floor has Bright skylights, hardwood floor, vaulted living room ceiling with fireplace, updated kitchen, formal dining area, 2 good size bedrooms and bath with double vanity sink. Lower level features a large bedroom ensuite bathroom with office area and spacious garage with storage and parking.  Backyard space ready for entertainment with low maintenance. Walking distant to Stonestown Galleria Mall, Restaurant, Lowell High School, Lakeshore Plaza, Stern Grove, Harding Park Golf Course, Lake Merced, SF State. Enjoy easy access to freeways and public transportation.
